name: Bubblibot
author: plugnify

sections.description:
Bubblibot brings GPT-5 nano’s speed and affordability to WordPress – intelligent AI chatbot that instantly learns from your content and provides instant, accurate answers to visitor questions.

With support for the latest AI models, your visitors get context-aware responses based on your actual content. The plugin automatically indexes your website and uses it to answer questions, reducing support tickets while improving user satisfaction.

Why Choose Bubblibot?

  • Direct OpenAI Integration – Use your own API key with no markup or middleman fees
  • Cost-Effective AI Models – GPT-5 nano offers 40% lower costs while maintaining quality
  • No Training Required – Works instantly with your existing content, no manual setup or training needed
  • Privacy Focused – Your data stays yours, GDPR compliant with anonymized analytics
  • Truly Free Core Plugin – No hidden costs, no usage limits, no premium gateway

Key Features

AI-Powered Intelligence

  • Multiple AI models
  • Automatic content indexing – instantly learns from your posts and pages
  • Smart search algorithms – multiple strategies ensure accurate results
  • Context-aware responses – answers based on your actual content
  • Three response modes – Company Data Only, Smart Hybrid, or Always Hybrid

Multilingual Support

  • 16 languages supported – English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese
  • AI-powered language detection – automatically detects and responds in user’s language
  • Customizable UI strings

Analytics & Insights

  • Track user queries and popular topics
  • Monitor answer rates and response times
  • Language distribution analytics
  • Usage patterns by hour
  • 30-day data retention
  • Identify content gaps from unanswered question

Technical Features

  • No coding required – configure everything from WordPress admin
  • Unlimited content indexing
  • No conversation limits – uses your own OpenAI API key
  • Automatic reindexing when content updates
  • Debug logging for troubleshooting

Perfect For

  • Service businesses
  • Content and blog sites
  • Local businesses
  • Any WordPress site needing smart chat

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate – Add Bubblibot to your WordPress site
  2. Add API Key – Enter your OpenAI API key (new accounts get $5 free credits)
  3. Automatic Indexing – Bubblibot scans and indexes your content
  4. Smart Responses – AI generates answers using your indexed content
  5. Continuous Learning – Updates automatically when you add new content or delete it

Response Modes Explained

  • Company Data Only – Strictly answers from your website content
  • Smart Hybrid – Prioritizes your content, uses general AI knowledge when needed
  • Always Hybrid – Combines your content with AI’s general knowledge

Pro Version Features

Upgrade to Bubblibot Pro for advanced capabilities:

  • OpenAI Embeddings – Semantic search for ultra-accurate answers
  • Conversation Memory – Maintains context throughout the chat session
  • WooCommerce support – Product search, pricing, inventory information
  • Lead Capture System – Intelligent forms with lead scoring
  • Human Handoff – Seamless transfer to human agents
  • Extended Analytics – 90+ day retention with advanced insights
  • Priority Support – Direct support from our development team

Learn more about Pro features

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 8.0+
  • OpenAI API key

External Services

Uses OpenAI API to generate chatbot responses.

Service: OpenAI API
URL: https://api.openai.com
Purpose: Generate AI-powered replies
Data sent: Chat messages + relevant page content
Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/
Terms: https://openai.com/terms/

Data Privacy:
* No personal data sent
* Anonymized analytics
* Optional admin-only debug log
* GDPR compliant
sections.installation:
From WordPress Admin

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search “Bubblibot”
  3. Install & Activate
  4. Bubblibot → Settings
  5. Enter your OpenAI API key
  6. Configure & save

Manual Installation

  1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/bubblibot
  2. Activate in Plugins menu
  3. Configure in Bubblibot → Settings

Get Your OpenAI API Key

  1. OpenAI API Keys
  2. Sign in / create account
  3. Generate key and paste into Bubblibot settings
  4. New accounts get $5 free credits
sections.faq:
Is Bubblibot free?

Yes, the core plugin is completely free. You only need to provide your own OpenAI API key. OpenAI charges for API usage based on the model you choose and the number of tokens processed.

How much does it cost to run Bubblibot?

OpenAI API costs are extremely affordable with Bubblibot. Even with 1,000 chats per day (30,000 per month), costs typically stay under $3/month with GPT-4o mini. GPT-5 nano is even more cost-effective, offering approximately 40% lower costs. Most small to medium websites will spend less than $1 per month on API usage.

Which AI model should I choose?

  • GPT-5 nano – Best for cost-conscious users who want fast responses
  • GPT-4o mini – Best balance of cost and quality for most websites
  • GPT-4.1 mini – Best for more complex queries requiring more reasoning

Does Bubblibot work in languages other than English?

Yes! Bubblibot supports 16 languages and automatically detects the user’s language from their messages. It will respond in the same language the user writes in.

How does Bubblibot learn from my content?

Bubblibot automatically indexes your published posts and pages when you install it. It updates this index whenever you publish or update content. The chatbot uses this indexed content to provide accurate, context-aware answers.

Will Bubblibot slow down my website?

No. Bubblibot loads asynchronously and doesn’t impact your page load times. The chat widget only activates when users interact with it.

Can I customize the chatbot’s appearance?

Yes, you can customize colors, fonts, position, welcome messages, and more. The chatbot can be styled to match your website’s branding perfectly.

Can I use Bubblibot with WooCommerce?

The Pro version includes full WooCommerce support with product indexing, price information, and inventory status. The free version will still work on WooCommerce sites but won’t index product-specific information.

What’s the difference between free and Pro versions?

Free version includes core chatbot functionality, content indexing, multilingual support, and basic analytics. Pro adds OpenAI Embeddings for better accuracy, conversation memory, WooCommerce support, lead capture, human handoff, and extended analytics.

How do I get support?

Free version users can use the WordPress.org support forum. Pro users get priority support directly from our team

Is my data secure?

Yes. Your content remains on your server and is never stored externally. Only relevant excerpts are sent to OpenAI when generating responses. The plugin is built following WordPress coding best practices with proper data sanitization, nonce verification, and prepared SQL statements. All analytics are anonymized and GDPR compliant.
